content: In the Buddha, the Dharma, and the Supreme Assembly,Until I reach enlightenment, I take refuge.Through the merit of my practice of generosity and the other perfections,May I attain Buddhahood for the sake of all beings.For myself and all sentient beings as vast as space,Upon a white lotus and moon disc at the crown of my head,From the syllable Hrīḥ appears the supreme noble Avalokiteśvara,Brilliantly white and radiating five-colored rays of light.With a gentle smile, he gazes with eyes of compassion.Of his four hands, the first two are joined in prayer.The other two hold a crystal rosary and a white lotus.He is adorned with silks and precious jewel ornaments.He wears an upper garment of antelope skin,And is crowned with Amitābha as his head ornament.His two legs are seated in the vajra posture,Resting against a stainless moon,He becomes the embodiment of all sources of refuge.Lord, your body is white and untainted by faults,Your head is adorned with a perfect Buddha,With eyes of compassion you gaze upon all beings,To Avalokiteśvara, I pay homage.To the noble Lord Avalokiteśvara,And to all the Victors and their heirsWho reside throughout the ten directions and three times,I pay homage with complete devotion.Flowers, incense, lamps, and perfumes,Food, music, and so forth—I offer these, both actually performed and mentally emanated;May the assembly of Noble Ones please accept them.From beginningless time until the present,The ten non-virtues and the five crimes of immediate retribution,All misdeeds committed while the mind was under the power of afflictions,I confess them all.Śrāvakas, Pratyekabuddhas, Bodhisattvas,And ordinary beings, and so forth—In whatever merit has been accumulated throughout the three times,I rejoice in all such merit.According to the intentions of sentient beings,And their various levels of mental capacity,I pray that you turn the wheel of Dharma,Of the Great, Small, and Common Vehicles.Until samsara is emptied,Do not pass into nirvana, but through your compassion,I pray that you look upon all sentient beingsWho are sinking in the ocean of suffering.Whatever merit I have accumulated,May it all become the cause for enlightenment,And before long, without delay,May I become a glorious guide for all beings.I pray to you, Guru Avalokiteśvara.I pray to you, Yidam Avalokiteśvara.I pray to you, Supreme Noble Avalokiteśvara.I pray to you, Lord of Refuge Avalokiteśvara.I pray to you, Loving Protector Avalokiteśvara.Hold me with your compassion, O compassionate Victorious One.Having wandered endlessly through infinite samsara,For beings experiencing unbearable suffering,There is no other refuge but you, O Protector.Grant your blessings so that I may attain omniscient Buddhahood.By the power of negative karma accumulated since beginningless time,Having been born in the hells through the force of hatred,May all sentient beings experiencing the suffering of heat and coldBe reborn in your presence, O Supreme Deity.Oṃ maṇi padme hūṃ.By the power of negative karma accumulated since beginningless time,Having been born in the realm of hungry ghosts through the force of avarice,May all sentient beings experiencing the suffering of hunger and thirstBe reborn in the supreme realm of Potala.Oṃ maṇi padme hūṃ.By the power of negative karma accumulated since beginningless time,Having been born as animals through the force of ignorance,May all sentient beings experiencing the suffering of stupidity and mutenessBe reborn in your presence, O Protector.Oṃ maṇi padme hūṃ.By the power of negative karma accumulated since beginningless time,Having been born in the human realm through the force of desire,May all sentient beings experiencing the suffering of toil and povertyBe reborn in the supreme realm of Sukhāvatī.Oṃ maṇi padme hūṃ.By the power of negative karma accumulated since beginningless time,Having been born in the asura realm through the force of jealousy,May all sentient beings experiencing the suffering of fighting and quarrelingBe reborn in the realm of Potala.Oṃ maṇi padme hūṃ.By the power of negative karma accumulated since beginningless time,Having been born in the god realm through the force of pride,May all sentient beings experiencing the suffering of death and downfallBe reborn in the realm of Potala.Oṃ maṇi padme hūṃ.Throughout all my successive births,May my activities be equal to those of Avalokiteśvara,Liberating beings in impure realms,And may the supreme speech of the six syllables flourish in the ten directions.By the power of supplicating you, the Supreme Noble One,May all beings who become my disciplesEarnestly adopt the law of cause and effect and strive in virtuous deeds,And for the benefit of beings, may they be endowed with the Dharma.Through praying one-pointedly in this way,Light rays radiate from the Noble One’s body,Purifying impure karmic appearances and deluded consciousness.The outer environment becomes the pure land of Sukhāvatī,And the body, speech, and mind of the sentient beings withinBecome the enlightened body, speech, and mind of Lord Avalokiteśvara;Appearance, sound, and awareness become inseparable from emptiness.Oṃ maṇi padme hūṃ.The physical appearances of myself and others are the body of the Noble One,All sounds are the melody of the six syllables,All thoughts and memories are the expanse of great primordial wisdom.By this virtue, may I quicklyAttain the state of Lord Avalokiteśvara,And may I establish every single sentient being, without exception,Upon that very level.By the merit of performing this meditation and recitation,May I and all sentient beings connected to me,As soon as we cast aside this impure body,Be born through miraculous transformation in the realm of Sukhāvatī.Immediately upon birth, having fully traversed the ten bhūmis,May I perform the benefit of others by sending emanations throughout the ten directions.
